author: reek
body: Regression: leaf-profile sizes a minimal leaf frame before the body is emitted, so it predicts the emitter's temp use and can guess low. Both shapes below profile at exactly four locals and then need a fifth -- m-swap's tail arguments permute and need a staging temp, p-shift's tail argument nests and needs more than one temp per complex argument. Each overran the frame it had been promised, and the emitter rejected valid Codex with CDX2000 rather than emitting it.

author: reek
body: A mispredict is now a retry through the standard path, so what these pin is that both compile at all and that the fallback emits working code: m-swap 7 111 222 = 222 (the arguments really do swap each iteration), p-shift 5 3 = -33.
